Summary: Module-level Review.query.all() causes RuntimeError: Working outside of application context on modern Flask
Steps_to_Reproduce: Import app or run under modern Flask/SQLAlchemy without an active application context.
Expected_Behavior: App should initialize cleanly and query reviews only when an active request context exists.
Actual_Behavior: RuntimeError: Working outside of application context thrown at import time.
Resolution: Encapsulated review retrieval inside dynamic get_random_reviews() helper and context processor.

Summary: Resume filename collisions and overwrites due to raw filename usage in save_picture()
Steps_to_Reproduce: 1. User A uploads resume.png. 2. User B uploads different resume.png.
Expected_Behavior: Each user upload should receive a unique sanitized filename without overwriting existing files.
Actual_Behavior: Second file overwrote the first user's resume file in static directory.
Resolution: Generated collision-resistant 16-hex token prefixed filename with lowercase extension.

Summary: Missing-file submission causes unhandled AttributeError (HTTP 500) in post_cvs
Steps_to_Reproduce: Submit ApplicationForm with all text fields filled but no file selected.
Expected_Behavior: Form validation should reject missing file with user-friendly error message.
Actual_Behavior: AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'filename' raised resulting in server 500 error.
Resolution: Added FileRequired validator to cv field in forms.py and defensive null checks in routes.py.

Summary: Broken Access Control (OWASP A01): Any logged-in user can view applicants for any job
Steps_to_Reproduce: Log in as Job Seeker or Rival Company and navigate to /show_applications/<jobid> of another company.
Expected_Behavior: Only the company that posted the specific job opening should have access.
Actual_Behavior: Any authenticated user could view candidate details degrees and experience.
Resolution: Added role check for Company and verified job.user_id == current_user.id before rendering.

Summary: Unprotected Resume Endpoint (OWASP A01): Resume images accessible without authentication or authorization
Steps_to_Reproduce: Navigate directly to /resume/<id> without logging in.
Expected_Behavior: Resume should be protected by login and restricted to the applicant or the job owner.
Actual_Behavior: Resume rendered publicly to unauthenticated guests and unauthorized third parties.
Resolution: Added @login_required and checked authorization (applicant ID or company job poster ID).

Summary: date_posted defaults evaluated once at module load time instead of dynamically per record
Steps_to_Reproduce: Inspect date_posted column definitions in Application and Jobs models.
Expected_Behavior: Default should pass callable date/datetime function evaluated at insertion time.
Actual_Behavior: default=date.today() called once at application startup causing stale timestamps.
Resolution: Changed default to callable datetime.now without parentheses.

Summary: Broken mod_pagespeed scripts and invalid relative stylesheets cause browser console errors
Steps_to_Reproduce: Load any page and inspect browser developer tools console.
Expected_Behavior: Page scripts should load cleanly without 404s or ReferenceErrors.
Actual_Behavior: Browser attempts to load non-existent scripts and fails with eval(mod_pagespeed_...) errors.
Resolution: Removed obsolete scraped scripts and linked local style.css while preserving Bootstrap 5 bundle.

Summary: Outdated 2021 dependency pins and UTF-16 LE encoding incompatible with Python 3.13
Steps_to_Reproduce: Run pip install -r requirements.txt in Python 3.13 on Windows.
Expected_Behavior: Dependencies should install cleanly without compilation failures or encoding issues.
Actual_Behavior: Installation failed due to unsupported legacy wheels (greenlet 1.1 bcrypt 3.2 Pillow 8.3) and UTF-16 BOM.
Resolution: Updated requirements.txt to modern Python 3.13-compatible versions with UTF-8 encoding.
